主题：Break Policy - Labor Law Compliance Reminder
Team,

Per state labor law, all employees working shifts of 6 hours or longer MUST receive a minimum 30-minute unpaid meal break. This break must begin no later than the end of the 5th hour of work.

Employees may request a shorter break only if their shift is under 6 hours. Any break request that violates the 30-minute minimum for 6+ hour shifts must be adjusted to at least 30 minutes.

Requests older than 48 hours should not be processed without re-confirmation from the employee, as shift schedules may have changed.

- HR Compliance"}
